newsitem.title: UK: JJB Sports down after press comment.
newsitem.headline: JJB Sports down after press comment.

text.p: Shares in British sports goods retailer JJB Sports dropped on Monday as a press report said there was speculation the company could be poised for acquisitions and a separate report said sports retailers were under a price-fixing probe.

Dealers said there was talk that the company could be seeking fresh finance to finance expansion plans, but played down a Sunday Times report that the Office of Fair Trading (OFT) was looking into the way prices were set in the trade.
"They might be trying to raise some money at some stage and while that is doing the rounds it is overhanging the shares," said one dealer, adding that the OFT probe was already known about.
The stock -- which reached a record 488p on April 24 -- was down 12-1/2p at 469 by 0832 GMT in thin trade of 14,025 shares.
Other sports retailers also fell, with Blacks Leisure Plc down 3p at 472-1/2 and John David Sports Plc down 3p at 347-1/2.
A report in the Daily Mail on Saturday highlighted JJB's appointment of SBC Warburg as its broker, saying the company "could go on the acquisition trail."
No-one at JJB was immediately available for comment.
